content.text: Creators in Cameroon face significant barriers when trying to sell digital products online. Payment platforms like Stripe are often unavailable, leaving many to struggle with outdated methods or complicated workarounds. This creates a critical need for a sovereign solution that empowers digital creators to transact seamlessly and efficiently. Today, you can deploy a payment [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-how-kenyan-creators-get-paid-5|infrastructure]] that leverages blockchain technology and Cloudflare's advanced capabilities, enabling you to accept payments with no servers required. It's time to take action and unlock your potential.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

You can set up a fully functional digital commerce stack in Cameroon without relying on conventional payment gateways. By utilizing NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Additionally, leveraging Cloudflare Pages for hosting and Google Apps Script for backend logic allows you to create a robust online store quickly. This infrastructure not only bypasses the limitations imposed by traditional payment processors but also provides a secure and efficient means to sell your digital products directly to consumers.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

To establish your digital storefront, begin with the Sovereign Starter Stack available for $97. This deployment includes [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-explained-14|GitHub Pages]] Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend processes, and NOWPayments for accepting crypto payments. With this stack, you can load three products and receive 30 days of support. The seamless integration with blockchain technology ensures that your transactions settle quickly, with USDT on the Tron network processing in under 60 seconds at a cost of less than $0.10, providing an efficient solution for your payment needs.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on building your store's core functionalities first before diving into advanced features that may not be necessary at the outset. Avoid [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-getting-paid-usdt-digital-work-complete-infrastructure-24|COREMERCH guide to getting]] caught up in extensive design tweaks or additional integrations that don’t directly impact your ability to sell. Prioritize establishing your payment system and product delivery mechanisms. By using available free resources like Google Drive for file delivery and Supabase for order storage, you can lay a solid foundation without unnecessary complexity. This streamlined approach enables you to start selling faster.
Deploy your infrastructure today and eliminate payment processing headaches.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Once your store is set up, it’s time to make your first sale. Ensure you’ve loaded at least one product and test your payment flow using NOWPayments. By utilizing Binance P2P, you can convert local currency into stablecoins like USDT, making it easier for international buyers to transact with you. Share your store link across social media channels to attract potential buyers. Remember to monitor your payment confirmations, as NOWPayments will automatically notify you when a transaction is completed, allowing for instant product delivery.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, commit to finalizing your store setup. Start by signing up for the Sovereign Starter Stack and deploying your GitHub Pages site. Load your first three digital products and configure NOWPayments to ensure everything is operational. Use social media to promote your store and reach potential customers, focusing on platforms popular in your region. Additionally, familiarize yourself with Binance P2P to understand how to manage local currency exchanges effectively. This proactive approach will set you on the path to successful sales.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Blockchain technology enables you to own your transactions without third-party interference.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Global access to digital product revenue is not contingent on where you are located — it is contingent on which infrastructure you build on. The sovereign stack works identically from Lagos, Accra, Nairobi, Karachi, Dhaka, Harare, or Manila. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours under your accounts, tested on mainnet before handoff. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete build for self-deployers. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.

Creators can utilize blockchain-based payment processors like NOWPayments, which allow for cryptocurrency transactions without relying on traditional gateways. This enables them to reach international customers and bypass geographic payment restrictions.

In Nigeria, creators can use platforms such as Binance P2P for currency conversion and NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrency. These solutions provide fast and secure payment options for digital products.

Yes, creators in Pakistan can use NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency for their ebook sales. This method does not require a Stripe account and allows for direct transactions with customers worldwide.
What are the benefits of using crypto payments for digital products?

Crypto payments eliminate the need for traditional banking services, providing faster transaction settlements and lower fees. Additionally, they offer enhanced security and privacy for both creators and buyers.
How does Cloudflare improve the infrastructure for digital sales?

Cloudflare provides fast and reliable hosting solutions, enhancing the performance and security of digital storefronts. By leveraging its services, creators can ensure a smooth user experience for their customers.
